A coquecigrue is utterly befuddling to behold. A creature that begins its turn within the area must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:24|name:Omnicolor Aura|traits:aura,enchantment,primal,visual|showDC:gm]{Will} Save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is immune to Omnicolor Aura for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of their next turn.

Critical Failure The target is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} until the end of their next turn.

The coquecigrue emits a mind-splitting warble, shredding the sanity of any creatures in a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] and causing them to lose their grasp on reality. Each creature in the area must make a @Check[type:will|dc:26|name:Mind-Bending Warble DC|traits:auditory,enchantment,incapacitation,mental,primal|showDC:gm]{Will} saving throw.

The coquecigrue can't use Mind-Bending Warble again for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is immune to Mind-Bending Warble for 24 hours.

Success The creature takes [[/r 3d8[mental]]]{3d8 mental damage}.

Failure The creature takes [[/r 6d8[mental]]]{6d8 mental damage} and is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes [[/r 12d8[mental]]]{12d8 mental damage} and is confused for 1 minute. A creature that critically fails its save while already confused is driven insane, becoming permanently confused. Only a 6th-level or higher @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.SnaLVgxZ9ryUFmUr]{Restoration} spell can remove this condition.

The coquecigrue hawks a ball of prismatic spittle at a creature within 30 feet. The coquecigrue makes a ranged Strike with a [[/r 1d20+19 #Prismatic Spittle]]{+19 bonus}; on a hit, the target takes 2d12+12 damage.

Roll [[/r 1d6 #Damage Type]] to randomly determine the type of damage dealt:

  1. [[/r (2d12+12)[acid]]]{Acid},
  2. [[/r (2d12+12)[cold]]]{Cold},
  3. [[/r (2d12+12)[electricity]]]{Electricity},
  4. [[/r (2d12+12)[fire]]]{Fire},
  5. [[/r (2d12+12)[sonic]]]{Sonic},
  6. The coquecigrue coughs ineffectually, dealing no damage.

details.publicNotes:
Found only in the depths of the most primordial forests, the coquecigrue is a bizarre creature that twists the minds of those who see or hear it. The forest for miles around a coquecigrue's lair is littered with the bodies of the creature's previous victims, many of whom went violently insane after their fateful encounter with this strange avian monster.

The coquecigrue is as bizarre to describe as it is to behold. It is said to have the head and legs of a twisted, fiendish rooster; a long, serpentine neck; and a bloated body covered in feathers that constantly and impossibly change colors. The monster's weakness is plain: Its green heart glows visibly from beneath its translucent breast, and those who know to strike this vital organ can deal massive damage. It is from this heart that the coquecigrue's most terrifying powers come from, including a soft, distorted tone that the coquecigrue can turn into a madness-inducing warble as it likes.

So far, no one has been able to slay a coquecigrue and return to civilization with its body. Even the number of these creatures is up for debate, since no two have been sighted together. Few reasonable people believe the outlandish reports of those who claim to have encountered even just one coquecigrue.

Bizarre Origins

The original coquecigrue was supposedly a child of one of the Great Old Ones, which became warped and twisted as it emerged on the Material Plane through a prismatic wall. Few believe this nonsensical origin story, though those who have faced a coquecigrue and lived to tell the tale aren't so quick to discount it.
